snippet.title: Shrine's Legacy - Official Demo Launch Trailer | The MIX Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Check out the Demo Launch Trailer for Shrine's Legacy, an RPG developed by Positive Concept Games. Players will explore a vast overworld while fighting in real-time battles using a robust combat and equipment RPG system to solve puzzles, learn spells, and more. Shrine's Legacy is coming soon to PC (Steam) with a demo available now.
